messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: sJ_L4vENW61XANefNc5v6Q

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "sJ_L4vENW61XANefNc5v6Q"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",

  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",

  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

parsed.title: The Mirror Road Through the Ruined City

scenes.caption: Mara unrolls the rescue map at the broken city wall.
scenes.visual_description: A cracked stone wall at dusk; an ink-stained coated figure spreads a hand-drawn map across rubble, brass compass glinting beside her.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of obvious temptations ahead.
scenes.visual_description: A small oil lamp held aloft, its single flame-eye narrowed; behind it, silhouettes of distant towers and tattered royal banners.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox scouts ahead through the rubble.
scenes.visual_description: A clockwork fox with a slowly winding key-tail picks across shattered cobblestones, blue glass eyes catching torchlight.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver slips out of a cracked window into the street.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet emerges from a tall warped windowpane as if from water, coat reflecting fragments of the ruined skyline.

scenes.caption: The party meets at the looming castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: Massive iron gates hung with faded royal banners; four figures gather in their long shadow under a bruised sky.

scenes.caption: They find the sleeping tax collector slumped at the gatehouse.
scenes.visual_description: An official snoring on a thick ledger book, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves, an overturned inkpot pooling near his boot.

scenes.caption: Mara avoids the cursed tower despite the lure.
scenes.visual_description: A leaning spire wreathed in violet mist beckons from across a courtyard; Mara turns her shoulder against it, tugging the lamp away.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox spies an armored patrol on the avenue.
scenes.visual_description: From behind a toppled statue, the metal fox peers at marching steel-clad figures whose faces are hidden by visors and banner-shadow.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver hides the team inside a shop mirror.
scenes.visual_description: A tall cracked mirror in an abandoned tailor's shop; four travelers ripple into its silver surface as the diver holds the frame steady.

scenes.caption: Frightened townspeople whisper of a winged beast in the clouds.
scenes.visual_description: Hooded townspeople clustered in a doorway, pointing up at a long serpentine shadow gliding above the ruined rooftops.

scenes.caption: The lamp insists the rumored beast is only a distraction.
scenes.visual_description: Close-up on the lamp's flame-eye, blazing brighter; in its reflection, the winged shape dissolves into mere smoke and banners.

scenes.caption: They reach a sealed magic door in the throne wing.
scenes.visual_description: An arched door etched with luminous runes pulses softly in a corridor lined with cobwebbed portraits and ripped tapestries.

scenes.caption: Tin Fox picks the rune-lock with a turning key-tail.
scenes.visual_description: The clockwork fox crouched against the door, its key-tail rotating into a glowing rune; sparks of pale gold drift upward.

scenes.caption: Glass Diver dives through a stained window to reach the captive.
scenes.visual_description: A vast stained-glass scene of an old royal hunt; the diver plunges into it headfirst, light shattering around the helmet.

scenes.caption: Inside the chamber, Mara finds the sleeping tax collector again, somehow.
scenes.visual_description: A dim chamber with a slumped official across the rescue route, ledger pages fluttering as Mara stares in disbelief, lamp glowering.

scenes.caption: They haul the dozing official out as alarms ring.
scenes.visual_description: Mara and the diver drag the snoring tax collector by the ankles down a torchlit staircase, stamped papers trailing like a paper comet.

scenes.caption: The team sprints onto the long bridge as patrols close in.
scenes.visual_description: A narrow stone bridge over a black river; four rescuers and one snoring bundle race across as armored shapes mass at the far gatehouse behind.

scenes.caption: On the far bank, Mara folds the map; the lamp finally smiles.
scenes.visual_description: Dawn over the river; the ruined city glimmers behind them, the tax collector still asleep on the grass, the fox curled on the map, lamp's eye softened to a warm crescent.
